headerDisplay:
This plugin simulates a CO2 air quality accessory that you can switch to the **detected** state when the power produced by your Envoy solar system reaches a threshold.
You can use this state to automate other tasks or just to get information. Current power is not displayed directly, but appears in the accessory settings under **Current level** in [ppm], but the value is in [W].
It can talk to your Envoy locally over HTTPS with a Bearer token (firmware D8+, hostname `envoy.localdomain` — get the token at https://entrez.enphaseenergy.com), or via the Enphase Cloud **API v4** (OAuth 2.0 with client_id/client_secret/refresh_token — the plugin renews the access token automatically).

token.title: Bearer token (static)
token.description: Long-lived JWT token for local HTTPS access. Generate it manually at https://entrez.enphaseenergy.com. Leave empty if you fill the Enlighten credentials below — the plugin will then refresh the token automatically.

enlighten_user.title: Enlighten username (email) — auto-refresh
enlighten_user.description: Your Enlighten account email. Combined with the password and serial below, the plugin logs in and renews the local Envoy token automatically (no manual token rotation).

enlighten_pass.title: Enlighten password — auto-refresh
enlighten_pass.description: Password of the Enlighten account above.

envoy_serial.title: Envoy serial number — auto-refresh
envoy_serial.description: Serial number of your Envoy / IQ Gateway (visible on the device or in Enlighten under 'Devices'). Required by Entrez to mint the token.

accessory_type.title: HomeKit accessory type

oneOf.title: CO2 sensor (default — exposes power in ppm and a Detected flag)

accessory_type.description: How HomeKit will display this accessory. The CO2 sensor type exposes both the current power (as ppm) and a boolean Detected flag — switching with the latter is the historical behaviour. The other types only expose the binary state, except 'lightsensor' which displays the current power in lux.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: API Key shown in your application page on https://developer-v4.enphase.com

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID of your Enphase application.

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: OAuth 2.0 Client Secret of your Enphase application.

refresh_token.title: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: OAuth 2.0 refresh token obtained via the authorization code flow. See README for instructions. Refresh tokens last ~1 month; the plugin auto-renews the access token from it.

type.title: Choose production values: inverters and eim
type.description: Please see ReadMe on github fo details

update_interval.title: Update interval
update_interval.description: Please note that API data is updated only every 15 minutes and access is limited (https://developer.enphase.com/plans). The free plan allowing to make 10'000 requests per month, by default it refreshes every 5 minutes (12 * 24 * 31 = 8928).
